newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Diperdana requotes higher at 21.00 rgt.
newsitem.headline: Diperdana requotes higher at 21.00 rgt.

text.p: Malaysian shipper Diperdana Corp Bhd shares requoted on Monday at 21.00 ringgit, up 20 cents.

Shares of the company were suspended on Friday pending a news announcement. Late that day, PDZ Holdings Bhd said Diperdana had offered to buy the entire company through an offer of three Diperdana shares for four PDZ stock.
PDZ's stock, which was also suspended on Friday, was not requoted on Monday. It closed at 13.70 ringgit on Thursday.

In a research note on Monday, Jupiter Securities said that based on Diperdana's Thursday closing share price of 20.80 ringgit, the deal would value PDZ at 772.2 million ringgit or 15.60 ringgit a share.
"The takeover price for each PDZ share is (a) 13.9 percent premium over PDZ's pre-suspension price of 13.70 ringgit," the note said. "Thus, there is more upside potential for PDZ share price."
Jupiter said Diperdana's parent Konsortium Perkapalan Bhd has ambitions to become Malaysia's largest shipper and hauler.
PDZ provides container shipping and related services for Southeast Asia. Diperdana is also involved in shipping, while Konsortium is focused on land-based transportation.
